name: Palo Alto Art Center Summer Camp Counselor in Training
org: City of Palo Alto Art Center
what_you_do: Help art teachers run kids' and teen summer art camps for at least one week, in a morning or afternoon session. You manage the classroom, encourage campers and prep art supplies.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 17. Morning or afternoon sessions.
deadline_text: CIT and Lead CIT registration opens Feb 4, 2027 with Enjoy! summer camp registration. No closing date stated.
how_to_apply: Register for a CIT or Lead CIT spot when Enjoy! summer camp registration opens on Feb 4, 2027. For the teen volunteer email list, email rebecca.passarello@paloalto.gov.
notes: Same page lists the Ceramics Apprentice Program (16 and older, 2 years of Art Center ceramics or instructor approval, 2 hours a week, one training session). Spots may fill fast once registration opens.
